test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

Farmers have harvested wheat __by using whatever labour__ that was available to them.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e.** 'by using limited labour'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Limited labour" **suggests making do with the available workforce, reflecting the situation described.
 
• It implies constraints or scarcity, which aligns with utilizing "whatever labour" was accessible.

Therefore, the correct answer is- **by using limited labour.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Option 1)** "by using amalgamated labour" **suggests combining labour sources, not necessarily limited availability.

Option 3)** "by using dispersed labour"** implies a spread-out workforce, not the focus on availability.

Option 4) **"by using united labour"** indicates collaboration, not necessarily reflecting limited resources.
